title: Great experience!
text:
It was a fantastic experience but I forgot Europe has very long day light in summer, if you want to see sunset please book after 8pm.

Overall the whole experience was wonderful, we thoroughly enjoyed it, it was a lovely experience and our boat captain Mark is friendly and informative.
author: Veronica_S

title: A fantastic outing; the treatment...
text: A fantastic outing; our captain Carlos's treatment has been spectacular and magnificent with us, and he was super polite, providing us with a comfortable space with blankets at the front of the boat, and additional blankets for the cold.
author: Alex_O

title: Everything was perfect:...
text: Everything was perfect: start on time, clean boat. We fully enjoyed the sunset in a beautiful atmosphere. Special mention to Fiona, who did everything to make us have a great time, and who even shared the atmosphere with us.
author: Mouna_O

title: perfect end to a day of sightseeing
text: First time in Barcelona and having a glass of champagne while sailing at sea was a nice celebration of a much anticipated holiday. Our skipper had excellent English and  was very informative about the buildings etc but also generally about living in Barcelona.
author: cathrynj699

title: Wonderful Boat Ride!
text: Absolutely incredible! We had stunning views of the sunset on water while sipping cava and eating some chips. Couldn’t have been more pleasant and wonderful! The tour guide was friendly, nice, and personable! It was truly our favorite thing of the whole trip!
author: Aidan_P

title: Boat
text:
Hello all wonderful people.
I would like to take my 8 years old daughter on this boat to experience the sunset in beautiful Barcelona. I don’t see any option that I could pay for a child. My question is if I buy 2xadults ticket would they allow my daughter get on the boat ? 
Or is it not child allowed ? 
Please drop some info if possible 
Thanks in advance
author: donnau243

title: Excellent experience
text: Mark was our captain and he could not have been more pleasant.  Highly recommend this beautiful sail around Barcelona.  A top highlight of our time here.
author: Diana_B

title: MARC IS AMAZING!
text: Our guide, Marc, was incredible! We had such a great sunset cruise and even got to jump into the Med and swim for about 25 minutes. The tapas and cava afterwards were great. Marc was very knowledgeable about the city line of Barcelona and we learned a lot of new info!!! Highly recommend booking this excursion
author: kellypost

title: All in global, boat, staff and experience
text:
Everything was ten, exceptional staff, attentive and very professional..
We will repeat again next year 
It was our wedding anniversary
author: Curious03329341984

title: Amazing boat trip
text: It was an amazing boat tour during sunset time.  So relaxing and enjoyable  experience. The Captain was an expert and made the ride so smooth and fun.
